ideas.title: Two more for dinner?
ideas.targetAudience: Home cooks adapting a dinner recipe for more people and a dairy-free request.
ideas.whyWatch: More guests create a real cooking-space constraint; quantities and method both matter.
ideas.visibleEvent: Purposeful food match cuts exclude floating-tray movement; genuine four-to-six and Dairy-Free selection leads to the exact recorded two-sheet/one-at-a-time method and a specific Original recipe CTA.
ideas.payoff: The recorded RecipeFix response adjusts the method to broil one sheet at a time and finish the chicken in sauce.
ideas.productBridge: Open Chicken Tikka Masala on RecipeFix and choose Make it fit.

variants.caption:
Two more for dinner. Same broiler.

In this recorded RecipeFix 4 → 6 Dairy-Free example, the method changes too: two foil-lined sheets, broiled one at a time, then a sauce finish. Open Chicken Tikka Masala → Make it fit.

AI planning illustration, not a cooked result. Historical October 21, 2026 response, not fresh inference. AI narration.

narration.script: Two more for dinner? Six servings, dairy-free. Same little broiler. Recipe Fix changes the plan, too: two sheets, one at a time. Open the recipe and tap Make it fit.

audioReview: unverified: founder must listen for naturalness, pronunciation and musical taste
creditAccounting: One full-script request. Immediate account counter lagged; delayed and final snapshots show 66 included credits consumed, 32,047 remaining. No new cash charge, overage, top-up or subscription change.
